mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_submission WHERE assignment_id=#{id} AND attempt_no>0
SELECT * FROM assignment_peer_feedback WHERE assignment_id=#{id} AND reviewer_id=#{user}

SELECT s.* FROM assignment_submission s JOIN assignment a ON a.id=s.assignment_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=s.student_id JOIN learning_enrollment e ON e.course_id=a.course_id AND e.student_id=s.student_id AND e.active=1 WHERE s.assignment_id=#{id} AND s.student_id!=#{user} AND s.attempt_no>0 AND s.status IN ('SUBMITTED','GRADED') AND u.status='0' AND u.role_id=10 ORDER BY (SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_peer_feedback p WHERE p.submission_id=s.id),s.id LIMIT 1

SELECT p.*,(p.attempt_no!=s.attempt_no) AS earlier_submission FROM assignment_peer_feedback p JOIN assignment_submission s ON s.id=p.submission_id WHERE p.assignment_id=#{id} AND s.student_id=#{user} AND p.sent_at IS NOT NULL AND p.hidden=0 ORDER BY p.id DESC

SELECT p.*,r.user_name AS reviewer_name,u.user_name AS student_name,(p.attempt_no!=s.attempt_no) AS earlier_submission FROM assignment_peer_feedback p JOIN assignment_submission s ON s.id=p.submission_id JOIN sys_user r ON r.id=p.reviewer_id JOIN sys_user u ON u.id=s.student_id WHERE p.assignment_id=#{id} ORDER BY p.id DESC
mapper.update: UPDATE assignment_peer_feedback SET strength=#{strength},suggestion=#{suggestion},sent_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP,version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND sent_at IS NULL AND hidden=0
UPDATE assignment_peer_feedback SET hidden=1,hide_reason=#{hideReason},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND hidden=0 AND sent_at IS NOT NULL
mapper.select: SELECT COUNT(*) FROM assignment_peer_feedback WHERE assignment_id=#{id} AND reviewer_id=#{user} AND submission_id=#{submission} AND attempt_no=#{attempt}
